**Email** — [hello@raccoonbg.com](mailto:hello@raccoonbg.com)

**Code and issues** —
[github.com/lassehjorthmadsen/raccoon](https://github.com/lassehjorthmadsen/raccoon).
Bug reports and questions about the engine are best filed as
[issues](https://github.com/lassehjorthmadsen/raccoon/issues).

We are especially interested in hearing from:

- **Backgammon players and analysts** with labelled position sets, rollout
  archives, or match databases we could benchmark against.
- **Researchers** working on stochastic games, distillation, or search-free
  evaluation.
- **Tool authors** who would like to embed the engine — the
  [Raccoon Game Protocol](architecture.md) is a UCI-style text protocol built for
  exactly that.
